note: DEBT, NOT A LICENCE. One entry per group the tripwire found in the test tree at base b712e8e, with a written reason; the notes on src/ apply unchanged. Folding a copy FORCES its entry out: tests/architecture/no-duplicate-implementations.test.ts reds BY NAME on any entry whose sites no longer match the tree (folded, renamed or moved), so a stale blessing cannot survive. Never add an entry to make a new copy green; baseline one only with a written reason and a named fold slice. FOLDING IS NOT DONE IN THIS SLICE: every entry is the measured debt this inventory declares.
scope: Every tests/**/*.ts and tests/**/*.tsx file EXCEPT tests/fixtures/** — captured upstream documents and prompt goldens legitimately repeat, and that directory is excluded (the only exclusion; it is pinned as data by the test, never left silent). Floor: 75 normalized characters, the SAME floor as the src/ inventory, measured and kept (docs/17 row 212): the ladder DOWN only adds noise (75 = 136 groups / 390 sites, 70 = 139, 65 = 142, 60 = 146, 40 = 158) and the ladder UP would hide cheap folds a seam could carry (160 = 98 groups, 200 = 85, 300 = 53, 400 = 33 — while the 8-site `walk` scanner normalizes to 349 characters, `completedWith` to 105, `removeEventListener` to 102 and the 8-site `stripComments` to 84). See the test doc comment for the normalization and what the tripwire cannot see (paraphrases and bodies under the floor).
